text: Sunil's daughter starts reception on Sept 4th. He's more nervous than she is lol. Text him that afternoon to see how drop off went
Zara got her A level results - straight As!! Off to Leeds to do medicine
zara driving test june 3rd, third attempt. v anxious about it. wish her luck the night before

Just got off the phone with Anika. Her son Reza finishes his GCSEs sometime in June and they're thinking of a trip to Portugal afterwards. Anika's been doing loads of pottery lately, she's got a wheel in the garage now. She said Reza's been really quiet and moody about the exams, so maybe I'll drop him a good luck card the week before they start.
Jada said her audition for the conservatoire is May 14. Practising cello four hours a day. Ask her how it went the day after
Phoebe's graduation ceremony got postponed, no new date yet. She's gutted
note to self - book my theory test before the end of the month
Sara and Jack are expecting their second, due sometime in the spring. Jack's mum is moving in to help for a bit
Valentina passed her driving test first time!!! Must send congrats

Coffee w Suzanne. Her grandson Gabriel had his first day at nursery Monday, cried the whole morning apparently but was fine by pickup. She's retiring end of next year, can't wait. Loves birdwatching, just got new binoculars. Her husband had a fall in the summer and is still using a stick, she's finding it a lot. Should pop round with a cake sometime soon
Hoang is sitting the bar exam July 28-29. Results not til November. Remind me to check in on him a week after, he'll be wiped
adriana's kid ellie has her ballet exam 5/14 then a recital the saturday after. adriana says ellie's not bothered at all, adriana is the stressed one
Alejandro has his citizenship test soon, didn't say exactly when. He's coeliac btw, remember for the dinner

So Bridget, Bridge, she rang about her nephew Darius who got into Cambridge, she was over the moon. Graduation for her daughter Efua is also coming up, June 21st I think, and she wants to do a little party the weekend after. Should get Efua a card before the ceremony.
Antoine failed his driving test again, third time. Really down about it. Need to call him this weekend
Demi's mock exams start after half term. Her dad says she's barely sleeping
Lorenzo and Hannah had their twins christened Sunday. Lovely do. Lorenzo's back at work in the new year
keisha's piano grade 8 got moved to march 3rd. she's been learning a chopin nocturne for it. pop round the evening before w snacks
Katarzyna mentioned her brother Sam is doing his PhD viva sometime next month. She keeps hinting he'd love a decent fountain pen when he passes
Haruto starts uni in Edinburgh in September. Studying architecture. His mum is not coping well with it
Ciara's son had his first swimming gala yesterday, came second in backstroke. She was so proud
Ilse cancelled her trip to Vienna, her dad's not well. Text her tomorrow to see how he's doing
Graham's retirement do is Oct 30th at the cricket club. I'm doing the slideshow
Uncle Dafydd has his cataract op November 12th. Aunty says he's fine but he's not, he hates hospitals. Ring him the day before and again the next day
Sunil said Reza (his nephew, not Anika's Reza) got a distinction in his piano exam. Proud uncle moment
Dentist Thursday 9am. Pick up dry cleaning after
Zara's little brother Jack got his 11 plus results, passed, going to the grammar. Their mum cried

Talked to Jada at the school gate. Her daughter's doing SATs in May, they're doing practice papers every evening. Jada works nights at the hospital now so it's mostly her husband doing them. She said things are a bit tense at home. Her son Alejandro has his driving test on April 17 too so it's a lot at once. Remind me to drop off that revision guide we don't need anymore
Phoebe - allergic to nuts, vegan, hates mushrooms. Into bouldering
Anika's daughter Zara (other Zara!) has her grade 5 violin on Feb 9. Don't forget to message Anika that morning to say good luck to her
Valentina and her partner are moving to Bristol sometime after Christmas. She's starting a new job there in January, something in marine biology

Sara rang. Her mum got her results back from the scan, all clear. Huge relief. Sara's taking her away to the Lakes next month to celebrate. Also her nephew Haruto finally did his driving test after three cancellations, passed, and her brother bought him a little Fiat. Sara wants to do a family dinner the weekend after they get back
Suzanne's audition for the amateur dramatics panto is next Tuesday. Wants the part of the fairy godmother badly. Ask her the day after if she got it
must ring the garage about the MOT before Friday
Hoang Le, uni mate, now works for a law firm in Manchester. Married to Ciara. Two kids, one starting secondary in the autumn
Adriana's dog Pepper had to have a tooth out last week. Back to normal now, eating everything

Alejandro Lopez, our new neighbour at number 12. Teaches Spanish at the college. Plays five a side Wednesdays. Seems nice, wife's called Valentina. Their eldest is doing her GCSEs this summer and the younger one starts reception in September. They've got a huge old greyhound called Duke. Said we should come over for drinks once they've unpacked

Efua told me she's re-sitting her nursing exam on April 2nd, she failed by two marks last time and is properly terrified. I said I'd take her for breakfast that morning. She also mentioned her mum's 60th is the week after and she's planning a surprise dinner at that Ethiopian place in town. Ask Efua about the result the following week, they publish it after ten days or so.
Darius got his black belt!! Grading was Sat. Kids club on Thursdays, he's been going since he was 7
Antoine and Demi's wedding is off. They split up in the summer apparently, Demi's moved back in with her parents
Dafydd's daughter Hannah finishes primary in July. Leavers assembly is July 18th, he's taking the morning off
Reza starts his driving lessons in the new year, he's 17 on Jan 6th. Keeps on about wanting a dash cam lol
Lorenzo said his niece Ciara has her first day at big school on 9/3 and she's nervous about the bus. He's driving her the first week
keisha - results day aug 13, wants to do law at UCL. text her that morning. and again the day after to see what she's decided
Katarzyna's cat Biscuit went missing on Monday. Still not back. She's beside herself. Check in tomorrow
Gabriel's in the school play, he's a shepherd. Show is Dec 11 at 2pm and again on the 12th. His mum Suzanne asked if I'll come to the Thursday one
Haruto passed his JLPT N2. Celebrating sometime next week, said he'd message when he knows
Ciara said Hoang's been stressed with work but they're off to Japan in the spring for two weeks, first proper holiday since the kids
Ilse got the job at the museum! Starts May 1st. Should send flowers before then
Graham's granddaughter Sara did her driving test this morning - passed. He's chuffed. He's got a new knee booked for the spring too, waiting on a date
Order more printer ink. Sort the spare room before the weekend

Dictated walking back from Jack's. Okay so Jack's son Sam has his first football trial with the academy on the 22nd, Saturday the 22nd, and Jack's a bag of nerves about it even though Sam is totally chill. Jack's wife Phoebe is away for work that week so it's just him. Also Jack mentioned his dad's 70th in November, they're doing a meal. Text Jack the night before the trial and ask how it went afterwards.
Sunil and his wife are doing the London marathon in April. He's been training since summer, knee's playing up a bit
Anika says Bridget's son has his medical school interview Dec 2. She's asked me to do a mock interview with him the week before
Jada's mum passed away last Thursday. Funeral's sometime next week, date tbc. Must send a card

Zara's starting her teacher training after Easter. Lives in Croydon now with her girlfriend Demi. She was worried about the interview but they offered her a place the same day. Demi's just qualified as a midwife, finished her final placement last week, and they're off to Lisbon at some point in the summer to celebrate both
Valentina mentioned her son's sixth birthday is on March 22nd, he's obsessed with dinosaurs. Lego dino set would go down well
Adriana's sister Katarzyna has a hospital appointment on the 4th about her back. Adriana's driving her. Message Adriana that evening

Long chat with Hannah after book club. She's thinking of doing an Open University degree in psychology, maybe starting in the autumn. Her husband Graham isn't keen. Their son Darius has his grade 3 trumpet the week before Easter. Hannah's also been having bad migraines and is getting them looked at soon. She seemed a bit flat honestly. Should check on her in a couple of weeks.
Nothing much from the parents' evening really, teacher was nice
